notes.E1: Share of national IT establishments (DENUE 05/2026: SCIAN 541510, 518210, 519290) divided by share of national on-campus higher-education students (911 2024-2025). Above 1: the municipality hosts more IT establishments than its share of students ("employs more than it trains").
notes.threshold: Municipalities with fewer than 3,000 on-campus students are excluded from E1 and E2 (template rule).
notes.periods: Population 2024 matches the 2024-2025 school cycle (D-MX-11); DENUE is 05/2026, the only edition used for D, J and N.
notes.missing: Municipalities created after CONAPO's 2024 release have no projection and are left without population (never zero).
